title: Implement agent permission resolution

feedback.content:
Implementation completed for agent permission resolution:
- Added `deepMergePermissions()` for merging permission objects
- Added `mapVisibilityToRule()` for backwards compatibility
- Added `resolveAgentPermissions()` with 3-layer resolution (defaults → role → overrides)
- Added `AcceptanceContext` interface for message acceptance checks
- Added `canAgentAcceptMessage()` for checking message acceptance
- Added `canAgentSeeAgent()` and `canAgentMessageAgent()` for visibility/messaging checks
- Added `DEFAULT_AGENT_PERMISSION_CONFIG` for sensible defaults
- All exports added to main index.ts

title: Implement Subscription pause/resume and overflow handling

feedback.content:
Implementation completed for subscription pause/resume and overflow handling:
- Added `state`, `isPaused`, `totalDropped` getters
- Implemented `pause()` and `resume()` methods
- Added overflow handler support via `on('overflow', handler)`
- Events still buffered during pause, handlers still receive events
- Async iterator properly waits during pause and resumes on `resume()`
- TypeScript compilation verified

title: Implement subscription acknowledgment support

title: Implement federation outage buffer

feedback.content:
Implementation completed for federation outage buffer:
- Created `ts-sdk/src/federation/buffer.ts`
- Implemented `FederationOutageBuffer` class with per-peer message storage
- Added configurable limits: maxMessages, maxBytes, retentionMs
- Implemented overflow strategies: drop-oldest, drop-newest, reject
- Added methods: enqueue(), drain(), peek(), stats(), count(), has(), clear(), clearAll(), peers()
- Automatic expiry of old messages before operations
- Size estimation for byte-based limits
- Exported from main index.ts
